test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure:

The state secrets had been smuggled out by a double agent before intelligence could act.

options.text: A double agent has smuggled out the state secrets before intelligence could act.
A double agent smuggled out the state secrets before intelligence could act.
A double agent was smuggling out the state secrets before intelligence could act.
A double agent had smuggled out the state secrets before intelligence could act.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The subject of the sentence performs the action.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The state secrets **had been smuggled** out by a double agent before intelligence could act."
 
• This sentence is in the **Past Perfect** tense in passive voice (had + been + V3).
 
• To convert to active voice, the structure is: **Subject + had + past participle (V3) + object**.
 
• The agent "a double agent" becomes the subject of the active sentence.
 
• The verb "had been smuggled" changes to "had smuggled."
 
• The original subject "the state secrets" becomes the object.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A double agent had smuggled out the state secrets before intelligence could act."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"A double agent has smuggled..." – Incorrect tense (Present Perfect).
 
• **Option 2: **"A double agent smuggled..." – Incorrect tense (Past Simple).
 
• **Option 3: **"A double agent was smuggling..." – Incorrect tense (Past Continuous).
